tiers.text: Ask Claude which columns of your dataset have missing values, and how many. (make list answers that once the tool exists.)
What should the page do with a zero on a log axis, or a row whose colour column is missing? Write it down in PLAN.md.

Two or three steps, each ending in something you can run and look at. Acceptance criteria you can check by eye or by test: 'the 3D view rotates', 'hovering shows the unit', 'the left-out count changes when I pick P1'. Then: 'commit PLAN.md'.
